description: The decode-through-ToM text arm's TAUGHT DATA + the stance-decode RULE (INDUCED_BELIEF_PREREG.md). Frame-symbol Concepts (the forecast frame: policy_rate_path / term_premium / inflation_target_credibility / balance_sheet + tenors/crosses) and a central-bank speech-act codebook (CBSpeechAct nodes mapping a grounded frame-symbol predication to a target-scoped stance) are TAUGHT data, not rule logic (CLAUDE.md: shape/data is acquisition, rule is execution). The DECISION -- which stance a decoded frame-symbol motion is -- is the seed RULE `ib_decode_stance` (an Eq-join of a FrameReading's decoded (symbol, motion) against a CBSpeechAct codebook entry, minting a StanceReading the adapter marshals into concept_apply_evidence via the UNCHANGED reasoning_can_bridge). NO surface-word cue matching: the codebook is keyed on the FRAME SYMBOL a read_clause grounded and the MOTION it carries, not on hawkish/dovish vocabulary (the level the phase-3 lexicon matched and that the thesis rejects). NO new Concept/belief mechanism: the target-scoped stance Concept is minted by domains/shared_arousal.mint_target_concept exactly as bigville ToM beliefs are.

rules.name: ib_decode_stance
rules.comment: THE DECISION: a decoded FrameReading{symbol, motion, market} whose (symbol, motion) matches a CBSpeechAct codebook entry mints a StanceReading carrying that codebook entry's stance/sign/direction/attr for the market. Eq-join (FrameReading.symbol==CBSpeechAct.symbol AND FrameReading.motion==CBSpeechAct.motion), guarded once per (frame_reading) by Not(Exists already-decoded). No surface-word matching; the codebook is keyed on the grounded frame symbol + its motion, not on cue vocabulary. `direction` is the sign's graph-data band direction (a codebook SIGN_DIRECTION lookup) copied onto the StanceReading so the decode reads the band direction off the graph rather than deciding it with a Python branch.
